name: io.github.rutvikdumre/personal-finance-mcp
description: Self-hosted, read-only MCP server for your bank, card and brokerage data via Plaid. Run locally or deploy in one click.

environmentVariables.name: PLAID_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your Plaid secret for the target environment (production or sandbox).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients must send. Required when the server is reachable beyond localhost (the Docker image listens on 0.0.0.0). At least 32 characters.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the MCP HTTP server listens on inside the container.
